rows.description: The Web composition no longer carries the Schedule rows; the Automation tasks optional bundle inserts them.
The legacy ui-chat.transcriptView value normal, and an unset value in non-Desktop Web, now display Detailed instead of Standard.
Account sign-in transport failures now report no-response instead of network.
Bundled NumPy and pandas omit their upstream test suites.
Custom primary-runtime payloads require relocatable Python interpreter aliases.
The runtime invariant registry package and every package's `./invariant` subpath export are removed.
The Automation tasks optional bundle is removed; the Web composition mounts Schedule itself.
Subpath plugins no longer read display text or icons from an exported <subpath>/package.json; they use locale meta and <subpath>/icon.
DeepSeek API-key model discovery requires a configured credential.
Desktop test builds require local opt-in before showing any Feishu update-policy authentication dialogs.
Explicit installation, peer dependencies, and configuration for optional hooks, webhooks, tools, and skills.
The `agent-instructions` row no longer accepts `dshHome`; instruction loading always resolves the harness home from `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`.
JobId now identifies one background execution across registry lifetimes.
JSONL persistence uses a namespace plugin import; direct service-class construction and class type annotations must use the persistence service instead.
Messages mock streams publish named SSE events for native SDK consumers.
Claude Code and Codex bundles add global delegation tools while retaining their package and row identities.
New Session creates a fresh Agent instead of reusing an existing empty Session.
dsh plugin reads --profile only before the forwarded pnpm arguments and prints its own help.
Python runtime wheels require explicit downloads for Office conversion and bundled authoring environments.
Python PTC compositions require sandbox services, and direct Python file operations follow the resolved file policy.
Custom title routes require registered adapters and reasoning efforts in increasing order.
Session-title providers register directly, own their strategy settings, and share only prepared execution.
SSH and Node PTC configurations use explicit launch modes, and SSH clients require a matching protocol-2 helper.
Managed subagent activations replace foreground and Job-backed delegation, its configuration keys, and the published in-process driver.
Subagent persona and toolFilter configuration is replaced by Agent Preset composition.
Agent Teams removes its pending-message limit and stops delivering historical queued mail.
Custom TerminalBlock consumers must provide localized accessible names for overflowing command lines.
Tool presentation accepts native or ptc; the mixed both mode is rejected.
The Web profile replaces the `webRuntime` service and the `web-runtime` row's `trustedHosts` config with `webStartup`, and rejects a wildcard listener host.
Session working directories replace built-in cwd configuration, and tool presentation metadata also runs for nested PTC calls.
Timer wrappers return void in TypeScript and ignore calls after disposal.
DeepSeekAccount.watch no longer includes Platform identity changes unless explicitly requested.
The DeepSeek account route no longer accepts a models catalog; the account listing supplies its models and modelOverrides adjusts them.
Desktop font-size shortcuts reserve key combinations previously available to custom shortcuts.
`--from-default-profile` now replaces an existing custom profile instead of refusing it.
Non-page Clients default to no forwarded interactions and use raw streams without browser recovery.
The pi-ai Azure provider route is renamed from azure-openai-responses to azure.
pi-ai routes that name a credential hide their models until the credential is configured.
With HMR, installing a package that is already installed fails with already-installed; an upgrade removes the package first.
viewProfilePackage from @deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/operations requires the manifest fields it prints.
The sdk-minimal default tool roster adds read_image and automatically summarizes older context.
Stored credentials now precede environment fallbacks when the store is mounted; the shipped headless profile omits stored authentication.
Plugin compatibility checks read engines.dsh before DSH peerDependencies, and refusals report requirements instead of peers.
AccountBonusNotification exposes unvalidated optional metadata and permits notices without an expiry.
Automatic model switches require a valid destination pressure budget and successful compaction.
Session model choices are fixed at step preparation, and projection types move to their owning package.
The maxBytes budget of @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions caps each instruction chain separately, so a baseline holding both chains can reach twice the configured size.
Custom subagent compositions must update model-selection settings and register discovery through main entries.
Agent creation and resume options rename parentAgent to ownerAgent for runtime ownership.
Agent Teams uses the standard subagent tools and Session ids; Team-specific creation, messaging, listing, interruption, and their configuration keys are removed.
Custom ApprovalService compositions must provide sessionProjections and await service activation.
Auto review Sessions retain their permission preset when the application closes and require the integration when reopened.
Auto review recognizes user-sourced task instructions across input transports and existing history.
Built-in language registrations conflict with third-party language packs using the same ids.

Tool declarations come only from step-admitted registrations: `system-prompt/assemble` no longer carries tools, conditional tools need a resolved step set, and `exit_plan_mode` is declared only after a Session first enters plan mode.
Custom Client compositions must provide the context-menu and file-action services required by GUI plugins.
Computer Use application consent moves from profile configuration to durable profile-scoped storage.
Standalone native CUA compositions must explicitly select global tool registration.
CUA relative coordinates accept integers from 0 to 999 and reject the former endpoint 1000.
Custom image factories and Markdown image delegates must supply file preparation callbacks.
Headless compositions that disable the command-line provider must supply their sandbox policy configuration directly.
The fixed 1017 model badge package is removed; model badges come from the DeepSeek model listing.
New Session reuses a blank Session in the Workspace again instead of creating a fresh Agent on every call.
DSH requires Node.js 24.9 or newer and no longer supports Node.js 22.
The bundle lists and profile templates move from @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot to @deepseek-ai/dsh-official-bundles.
Persistent-terminal bundle controls leave the Plugins page; profile configuration still enables and disables the bundle.
Undescribed pi-ai models inherit larger context and output capacities unless the provider configures explicit defaults.
The pi-ai 1.3.0 catalog removes model IDs and lowers some model capacities.
pi-ai 1.3.0 changes provider protocols, reasoning choices, history replay, and invalid tool-argument handling.
PTC programFormat includes Script syntax, and consumers read retainsState for cross-call memory.
The existing SDK profile includes native desktop tools and model context.
The sdk-minimal profile now stops model and tool dispatch when session persistence cannot complete a checkpoint.
Session projection registration resolves asynchronously to a retained reader; the callable result and registry-level state reads are deprecated.
Store-owned Sessions reject writes before creation announcement completes and after removal.
Agent Teams defaults off for new Sessions and uses a saved per-Session selection.
SubagentActivationSpec accepts task options directly instead of a nested request object.
The subagent service removes drainChildren, listChildren, and list.
Subagent user controls address only the target Session, rename the interrupt endpoint, and require target Session permissions instead of global permissions.
Tool execution modes move from dsh-tools configuration into explicit executor plugins.
The HTTP fetch provider no longer rejects non-public destinations, and HttpFetchProvider no longer accepts an address resolver.
WebServer index rendering takes the Peer the page speaks for, and the `webserver/index-inject` event passes that Peer to listeners.
Image read requests require a complete attachment reference and no longer check Session membership.
Computer Use needs permission for its own helper application instead of the terminal that launches DSH.
macOS Computer Use grants use bundle identifiers and require renewed consent for old application identities.
Generated worktree names replace the worktree- prefix and full UUID suffix with dsh- and Session-derived names.
Task-board changes no longer end wait_agent calls; send a message to request further work.
Ordinary Session forks stop recording their source relationship and stop appearing as subagents.
Caller-cancelled run_code results use ABORTED instead of CODE_RUN_FAILED.
Session follow callers must explicitly request background Agent activation.
Agent factory ownership parameters and registry tree queries are removed; subagent Activations own runtime tree membership.
The Team mode slash command is removed; use the root conversation menu.
Team projection stops restoring historical teammates and mailbox state while retaining tasks and saved mode.
Custom file-action menus must offer save-as only on Desktop and browser downloads on Web.
One web_search call accepts 10 queries and returns 10 sources by default, and the DeepSeek Search API provider paces its requests.
DeepSeek model listings refresh automatically after first use, and custom listing-cache owners must supply live settings and change notifications.
Reasoning Body Slot text carries display-ready content, with original output in rawText.
The sandbox package removes SandboxUnsupportedPolicyError; Windows processes ignore additional writable roots.
Client plugins must use the prefixed context menu types and hooks and register keyed icon components.
Loader entry trees report mutations through commit(change), and Include persists them through a journal.
Client UI consumers must replace JavaScript panel positioning and Menu rectangle callbacks with CSS anchors.
Source-built Computer Use helpers use a separate development bundle identifier and need one new macOS permission grant.
The Desktop stable update channel is named stable instead of latest.
Forge Git queries use Session permissions and disable configured diff helpers.
The Plugins page replaces the standalone Git worktrees card with Change requests & worktrees.
The fs-observation-policy row ships disabled, so write, edit, and apply_patch no longer require a prior read, and dsh-base plus the Web standard preset gain apply_patch.
`new LlmError` accepts only built-in failure codes; other codes go through `LlmError.fromFailure`.
Auxiliary LLM request purposes require producer-owned type declarations instead of a shared fixed union.
pi-ai routes now offload the oldest history images once a request carries more than 50 retained images.
Live Session projection frames list every key one committed event changed instead of carrying one key each.
`ctx.sessionProjections.checkpoint(session)` keeps a released unit's last row instead of omitting it.
Projection snapshot reads compute only the returned units, the registry cached snapshot read is deprecated, and Session list summaries omit context pressure and breakdown.
Retained Node PTC uses cooperative stop on timeout or cancellation, with process termination when acknowledgment fails.
The Schedule model tools become `schedule_create`, `schedule_list`, `schedule_view`, and `schedule_edit` over every Host task, and `schedule_update` and `schedule_delete` are removed.
Schedule clients use one Host-wide management API and typed timing records; stored Host tasks keep the existing domain and layout.
SDK run recognizes native commands and returns RunResult after its input completes.
Custom Web compositions must provide context menus for Session actions, and export dialogs now remain visible across Session switches.
Subagent reasoning overrides require an explicit provider and model, and explicit routes use model-default reasoning when effort is omitted.
DeepSeek web search and fetch take their endpoint from the DeepSeek model route; the shared baseURL, apiKeyEnv, and apiKey fields are removed in favor of per-capability fields.
The shipped Search default moves from legacy Messages search to the DeepSeek Search API, and the optional Exa and Perplexity search packages are removed.
Chat ProcessActivity gains a context category, and the running activity uses RunningProcessActivity.
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-office-kit` replaces `@deepseek-ai/dsh-office-to-pdf`, renaming its service, Remote methods, exported types, and configuration row.

The `office-render`, `office-recalculate`, and `office-export-pdf` skills, the skill-office `node` and `cli` keys, and two Office CLI environment variables are removed; Office operations use skill-activated tools.
`DSH_BUNDLED_OFFICE_SKILLS` and the `office-skills/` resource directories are removed; Office skills load from the `skill-office` package's assets.
Subagent control and Team task tools address agents by name, list_agents rows change, and subagent catalogs write payload version 3.
Generic account notification APIs replace bonus-specific methods and notification requests use the Harness domain.
Move account plugin composition and Remote imports to the concrete deepseek-account service.
Archiving a Session can remove its clean worktree while retaining the branch, and the Forge bundle mounts one worktree service.
AttachmentError now extends HarnessError, so tool and model-request failures record attachment codes instead of losing them or reporting UNKNOWN.
macOS reads more AX nodes by default and accepts per-read overrides of configured traversal budgets.
macOS mouseMove requires AX alternate UI by default and returns HOVER_UNAVAILABLE instead of moving the user's cursor.
Migrate CUA scripts and custom native providers to scoped window input, string element IDs, and platform capabilities.
Creator mode replaces its four skills with one `dsh-doc` skill, and the repository documentation skill becomes `dsh-doc-writing`.
ChangeRequestSnapshot gains required overview fields, ChangeRequestCheck gains the required rerun field, and ForgeActionFailure gains the unknown code.
ForgeProvider.diff and ctx.forge.diff take the head commit to read, ForgeFailure gains the stale code, and ChangeRequestSnapshot gains threadsTruncated.
ForgeFailure gains the unsupported code, which ctx.forge.readReview returns for a provider without review reads.
BundleInfo.updatable is replaced by BundleInfo.update, and ManagementError gains the unexpected-package code.
Runtime-context log text gains reminder framing, and clear markers record empty snapshot sections.
Code that replaces Session.append must implement both the single-event and array overloads.
Built-in configurations disable interrupt_agent for subagents and Team mode.
TerminalBackendCleanupError extends TerminalError instead of AggregateError and carries the CLEANUP_FAILED code.
The experimental terminal bundle opens Agent terminals in the Web sidebar and replaces its optional-terminal-bash and optional-terminal-pwsh rows with optional-terminal-panel.
DeepSeek Search and Fetch add per-capability billing and replace provider authentication fields with ordered credential sources.
Custom Client overlays that relied on global macOS no-drag exclusions must declare their window regions.
Client artifact metadata and static library manifests require rebuilding custom browser bundles and updating direct static-artifact consumers.
WebServer routes require authentication by default, and default Token login moves to a Provider plugin.
Cordis 4.0.0-rc.12 replaces ctx.root with ctx[Context.root] and renames the service intercept-metadata API.
A native CUA provider configured with a preset id now gives Agents without an Agent preset the cua_run_code tool.
Update direct dependencies and configuration overrides for the renamed macOS Computer Use provider.
macOS CUA returns marked partial AX observations and distinguishes observation failures from stale input snapshots.
Keep a longer image upload deadline on slow DeepSeek gateways.
Experimental and hook plugin tool failures record error codes, NativeError, OarFailure, and StagehandDrainError become HarnessError subclasses, and browser cleanup rejects with BrowserSessionError.
Update removed package subpaths; retained identity constructors remain available.
Python PTC runtime packages, external providers, SDK renderers and Python-specific binding APIs are removed; migrate to TypeScript PTC.

Session status types and the useSessionStatus hook move to @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session-status/client, ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus becomes an injected service, and completion reminders follow Host reading records.
ui-primitives no longer exports rankByName, and popupSelect commands no longer accept searchMode.

bash and pwsh report unadvertised sandbox_permissions and run_in_background as ToolArgsError, JOB_BACKGROUND_DISABLED is removed, and read_image reports MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES instead of IMAGE_UNSUPPORTED_MODEL.
Personalized recommendations cards come from action-card blocks in answers; the propose_action tool, the action-cards queuedMessageLimit field and the callId card field are gone.

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-hmr` removes `GET /plugins/events` and `EVENTS_ENDPOINT` for the authenticated `pluginEvents/follow` Remote stream, and browser plugins receive synced configuration in `apply`.
The cordis_inspect tool replaces cordis_inspect_list and cordis_inspect_query.
Cordis Loader 1.0.0-rc.9 and Include 1.2.0 parse YAML 1.2, reject malformed entries, and return PatchResult from applyEntryPatches.
The `create_worktree` model tool is removed; `enter_worktree` creates a worktree or enters an existing one of the same name.
Direct DeepSeekFileStore callers must supply a resolved file upload policy.
The DeepSeek streamed content refusal code changes from MALFORMED_RESPONSE to CONTENT_REFUSED.
